recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work groups want ValueSet.publisher and steward separated again, open a new tracker that explicitly revisits FHIR-35987 rather than reapplying FHIR-29944 in isolation.
issue_request: FHIR-29944 was a Published/Persuasive vocab change request for R5 asking to remove the steward alternate name from ValueSet.publisher and update comments so publisher was not implied to be synonymous with steward.
initial_application: Commit b0172dd266bc5061422826c714e77a6d3c559296, which explicitly mentions FHIR-29944, removed alias value="steward" from the then-current source/valueset/structuredefinition-profile-shareablevalueset.xml profile source. That old profile file was later migrated/deleted, but the history shows the original seed request was applied.
additional_context: FHIR-35987 is a later Published/Persuasive with Modification decision for R5 that explicitly says publisher is a synonym for steward and resolves to the short name 'Name of the publisher/steward (organization or individual)' plus a release-and-ongoing-maintenance definition. Vocab minutes tied removal of valueset-steward to FHIR-35987 satisfying the definition of steward, and FHIR-I minutes record approval of FHIR-35987 by 15-0-0. Current active ValueSet source and notes intentionally reflect this later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Removing steward wording now would contradict the later FHIR-35987 decision and current ValueSet/VSD alignment source.
